entities.summary: Adam Mair is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Toronto Maple Leafs, Los Angeles Kings, Buffalo Sabres and the New Jersey Devils. He was a player development coach for the Buffalo Sabres until October 2025 when he was charged with felony DWI for driving with his children in the car while intoxicated during a traffic accident in September 2025.
